content.summary: Security review findings for claude-agent-sdk integration (origin/dev diff)

findings.title: Tool input logged verbatim in metadata registry

source.snippet: const json = typeof input === "string" ? input : JSON.stringify(input)

sink.snippet: log.info("store", { tool, key: k, metaKeys: Object.keys(data.metadata ?? {}) })

findings.attack_vector: Invoke task tool with a prompt containing secrets; the JSON-stringified input is logged as the registry key.
findings.impact: Sensitive prompt/tool input can be persisted in logs or telemetry systems.
findings.recommendation: Remove raw key logging or replace with a stable hash/redacted summary.
findings.code_fix: const keyHash = Bun.hash.xxHash32(json).toString(16); log.info("store", { tool, key: keyHash, metaKeys: Object.keys(data.metadata ?? {}) })

findings.title: Metadata registry key lacks session scoping
flow: → key() uses tool+input only (no session scope)
→ metadata attached to tool-result for a different session
findings.attack_vector: Two sessions invoke task tool with identical prompt/description within TTL; metadata from the first can attach to the second.
findings.impact: Cross-session disclosure of session IDs and tool metadata (summary/model).
findings.recommendation: Key metadata by sessionID/messageID/toolCallId or include session namespace in the registry key.
findings.code_fix: function key(tool: string, input: unknown, sessionID: string) { return `${sessionID}::${tool}::${hash}` }
